# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 096

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 2375–2399, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. I rewrote all 25 gloss/example pairs in natural Hindi. Several examples had drifted to another sense or context, including `wise`, `neglect`, `cheese`, `mystery`, `composition`, `sanction`, `potato`, `liability`, `attraction`, and `determination`; these were aligned with the English source.

Changed: 25 Hindi gloss/example pairs.

Progress: 2,400/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (27.16%); 6,437 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
